test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

They have built a new bridge across the river.

options.text: A new bridge has been built across the river by them.
A new bridge by them has been built across the river.
A new bridge has built across the river by them.
The river has been built a new bridge by them.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They have built a new bridge across the river."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "**a new bridge"** at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "have built" to **"has been built"** (present perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition** "by"** followed by the original subject "them."
 
• Ensure the phrase **"across the river"** remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A new bridge has been built across the river by them."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"A new bridge by them has been built across the river." – Incorrect word order.
 
• **Option 3: **"A new bridge has built across the river by them." – Missing auxiliary verb "been".
 
• **Option 4: **"The river has been built a new bridge by them." – Incorrect subject (the river).
